Objective: Define security oversight, responsibilities, and decision rights.
Maintain approved security policies, standards, and procedures.
Assign accountability for control ownership and execution.
Track, approve, and review exceptions to security controls.
Review risk, incidents, and security metrics on a recurring basis.
Measure and report control effectiveness and risk trends.
Review, update, and retire controls as business and technology change.
Define awareness program scope, frequency, and accountability.
Ensure security controls are funded and staffed.
Keep security documents version-controlled and current.
